dedupe_keys.name: portugal mainland transport networks at 1 200 000 rail roads airports and maritime transport from the direcao geral do territorio high value dataset

description: The Portuguese national mapping and land agency, the Direção-Geral do Território (DGT), publishes the transport networks theme of its 1:200,000 national cartographic series as open data, listed as an EU high-value dataset under Implementing Regulation 2023/138. Contents: the rail network, the road network, airports and maritime transport for mainland Portugal, generalised for small-scale national mapping; sibling themes in the same series cover hydrography, hypsometry and toponymy. Producer: DGT. Coverage: mainland Portugal (the Azores and Madeira are not included). Format and access: a ZIP download of about 8.3 MB through the DGT INSPIRE Atom download service (last modified June 2024), plus WMS and WFS services; guides to using the services are on the DGT open data pages, and metadata is in the national catalogue SNIG. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, public access without restrictions. Caveats: 1:200,000 generalisation means simplified geometry and limited attributes, so it suits national overviews, not asset-level work; the 2024 date lags recent motorway and rail openings. Simulation uses: national multimodal network skeletons for accessibility and freight studies, exposure screening of the main road and rail corridors to wildfire and flood hazards, and a base network for linking regional datasets. Related records: ANACOM coverage data (data-anacom-geo-coverage-portugal) cover Portugal's telecom networks.
